content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-12. - Reserved.
content.summary:
Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4830
, § 2, adopted December 5, 2022, repealed § 58-12, which pertained to fines and sentences;
               suspension or stay of execution and derived from § 1-9.1 of the 1960 Code; § 18-16
               of the 1981 Code.
